title: centaurea arenaria subsp. odessana
intro: Centaurea arenaria subsp. odessana, commonly known as Odessa knapweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its distinctive appearance and medicinal properties. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and support wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Odessa knapweed include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to the interactions of its bioactive constituents, which may provide relief from various health conditions, including respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems.
